set.body: General JavaFX lifecycle owner ScalaDock. Add default-allow async PaneView close preparation plus cancellation notification; route Dock.close, pane context close, tab/group close through same transaction. Public awaitable close-all for host shutdown. Preserve immediate default close, all-or-none group veto, duplicate request handling, failed futures fail closed, stale bound pane identity protection and force update/dispose distinction. Verify native FX tests including delayed gates, veto/failure/retry, group atomicity and cleanup.
set.title: Admit pane and group closure asynchronously before disposal
